plan.title: Reverse Auction Auto Title for Two Products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event to an auction configuration without entering a title.
Apply the reverse auction template so the pricing sheet and reverse-auction title behavior are available.
Add the first specified product while leaving the title empty.
Confirm the first product has the requested location.
Add the second product from a different family.
Set the second product to the same location.
Confirm the second product has the requested location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB & more - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the automatically generated title for two products at one location.
Remove the second product without having typed a custom title.
